item.title: Find old versions: ONLYOFFICE Docs: Server Path Traversal
item.description:
ONLYOFFICE Docs: Path traversal (file read/write) · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 5.6.3

First step: This flaw dates from 2021, but CISA only now lists it as exploited. Find any system that still runs an affected version of ONLYOFFICE Docs, and update or retire it.

ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2021-3199
